correctness.rationale: Path-basis J has vector spaces U⊕F_q⊕W⊕U⊕W⊕(U⊗W), dimension 2a+2c+ac+1. Commutator equations are tu−sv=0, sx−tw=0 and u⊗y−v⊗z+p⊗x−r⊗w=0. Top paths are central, giving factor q^(2ac). When (s,t)=0, rank-r a×4 matrix M and 4×c matrix N give MN=0, contributing Z=sum R_(a,4)(r;q)q^((4−r)c). When (s,t)≠0, u=su0,v=tu0,w=sw0,x=tw0, and remaining tensor map P0⊗w0+u0⊗Q0 has rank 0,a,c,a+c−1 in the four zero/nonzero configurations. Its kernel counts yield T and the q²−1 scalar multiplier, exact in all characteristics. Burnside commuting pairs / |J| yields class number of 1+J. Independent modular commutator-matrix rank enumerations for (a,c,q)=(1,1,2),(1,1,3),(2,1,2),(1,2,2) reproduced 1024,41553,30208,30208. They corroborate but do not prove the all-prime-power formula.
